mapper.select: SELECT d.plan_date AS date, t.id AS task_id, t.title AS task_title, t.subject_id, t.unit_id, u.name AS unit_name, SUM(d.planned_amount) AS planned_amount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM study_record r WHERE r.task_id=t.id AND r.record_date=d.plan_date AND r.deleted_at IS NULL),0) AS completed_amount, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d.source)=1 THEN MIN(d.source) ELSE 'MIXED' END AS source, CASE WHEN COUNT(d.estimated_minutes)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(d.estimated_minutes) ELSE NULL END AS estimated_minutes, MIN(d.sort_order) AS sort_order FROM daily_plan_item d JOIN task t ON t.id=d.task_id JOIN study_unit u ON u.id=t.unit_id WHERE d.source <> 'REVIEW' AND d.plan_date >= #{start} AND d.plan_date <= #{end} AND t.subject_id=#{subjectId} GROUP BY d.plan_date,t.id,t.title,t.subject_id,t.unit_id,u.name ORDER BY d.plan_date,sort_order,t.id
